# Requirements Quality Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that the approved requirements are complete, clear, consistent, measurable, and traceable
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Legend**: `[M]` mandatory (a constitution MUST, an approved requirement, or an approved decision); `[O]` optional enhancement or backlog boundary. `G0` is evaluable now against the approved specification, plan, ADRs, and contracts; `G1` is evaluable after `/speckit-tasks` and `/speckit-analyze`, before implementation. `{Detects: ...}` links an item to a failure pattern in the [README](README.md) detection matrix. Dimension tags: Completeness, Clarity, Consistency, Measurability, Coverage, Traceability, Edge Case, Assumption, Conflict, Gap.
## Completeness and Identity

- [ ] CHK001 - Is every requirement uniquely identified (FR, NFR, DEC, ASM, CON, EXC, LIM, SC) with no duplicate or reused ID? [Traceability, Spec "How to Read"] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK002 - Does every FR have at least one AC, one NAC, and an Evidence type? [Completeness, Spec FR-001..FR-133] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is each requirement classified exactly once (Confirmed, Derived, Proposed) with its source cited? [Clarity, Spec classification table] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are the official assessment requirements held as a distinct source, or is their absence recorded as an assumption? [Gap, Spec DEC-005] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are user types (API consumer, engineer, approver, release owner, assessment reviewer) each mapped to a journey, acceptance scenarios, and a credential role? [Coverage, Spec US-1..5, DEC-018] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are in-scope and excluded capabilities explicit and consistent with the plan (no GUI, no production deployment)? [Consistency, Spec EXC-001..006] [M, G0]

## Clarity and Measurability

- [ ] CHK007 - Are the vague terms "material change", "material ambiguity", "mandatory policy", and "unresolved finding" each defined with testable criteria? [Clarity, Spec DEC-046, DEC-047, DEC-048, DEC-054] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK008 - Can each approved numeric target be measured, and is each labelled a demonstration goal rather than a client requirement? [Measurability, Spec PVT-001..015, DEC-003, DEC-013] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is each NFR verifiable by a named evidence type and linked to a PVT or test category? [Measurability, Spec NFR-001..011] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK010 - Does each NAC describe a forbidden outcome a test can observe? [Measurability, Spec FR-001..FR-133] [M, G0]

## Consistency and Conflicts

- [ ] CHK011 - Is FR-128's literal "every mandatory policy check is PASS" reconciled with ADR-014's CONDITIONAL_PASS disposition that can allow READY with accepted conditions? [Conflict, Spec FR-128, ASM-013, ADR-014] [M, G0] {Detects: unsupported-completion-claims}
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the four-outcome rule of FR-124 consistent with a derived disposition that keeps the evaluation outcome FAIL? [Consistency, Spec FR-124, DEC-108] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are the 24-hour approval window, 24-hour policy-block window, 60-second lease, and 24-hour retention each distinct in purpose and non-conflicting? [Consistency, Spec PVT-008, DEC-030, DEC-031, DEC-045] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is GET-only analytics (DEC-104) reconciled with FR-012 text, or is the pending change recorded with owner and decision point? [Gap, Spec FR-012, DEC-104] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is MTTR required by a specification requirement (formula, unrecovered excluded), or defined only in plan and ADR-008? [Gap, Spec FR-131, ADR-008] [M, G0]

## Coverage, Boundaries, and Change

- [ ] CHK016 - Are failure paths defined for each external dependency the plan names (PostgreSQL, Redis, inbox, git, package index)? [Coverage, Plan §1.2, Spec FR-019, FR-021] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is each open item (ASM-008 sub-items, DEC-104, DEC-105) recorded with an owner and decision point? [Completeness, Spec ASM-008] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is post-approval change handled by impact analysis, change approval, and a recorded version bump? [Completeness, Spec FR-126, Decision Record] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are requirements for GitHub evidence and submission packaging in the specification, or deliberately held in the plan only? [Gap, Constitution X, Plan §9] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are backlog items (BL-01..BL-07) kept out of requirements and labelled non-binding? [Consistency, Plan §6.1] [O, G0]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items marked `[Gap]` or `[Conflict]` name a place where the current documents are silent or disagree; they are findings for the reviewer to resolve, not pre-judged results
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially within this file (`CHK001` onward); cite them as `<file>:CHKnnn`
